facts.fact: Augentic's CEO said its contract for Cameroon's new ID card includes 1,000 portable verification kits for law enforcement officers to do instant biometric authentication and verification of identity documents.

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports Cameroon's new national ID card system went live on 17 February 2025 with online pre-enrolment, biometric capture a week later and the first cards given to applicants on 3 March 2025.
